name: News platform
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends ffmpeg unzip xz-utils && support/scripts/mobile-toolchain.sh && echo '. /home/vscode/toolchain/env' >> ~/.bashrc
postCreateCommand: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/0.13.9/install.sh | sh && export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && (cd backend && uv sync --locked)
